name: Flower Mahjong Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Flower Mahjong Connect is a mahjong game based on gardening. Unlike other mahjong games, this one requires there to be no more than two 90-degree angles between matching tiles. The tiles in this online game are garden-themed with icons like flowers, rakes, buckets, trees, and butterflies. The tiles are set against bright and lively garden scenes like cottages, tea time, and yards. There are 40 levels to this online game for you to play. Each level presents its own challenge and is limited with time. Match all the tiles before the timer runs out to advance to the next level. If you fail to match the tiles before the timer is up, you lose the game. At the end of the games, submit your score to see if you land on the list with the top players. Play again to rise up the leaderboards and be the top player!
